title: TRANSPORTATION COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the City's current active transportation projects and associated grant deadlines.
text:
[Council File 26-1376]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
TRANSPORTATION COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the City's current active transportation projects and associated grant deadlines.
Recommendations for Council action, pursuant to Motion (Hutt – Jurado):
INSTRUCT the Los Angeles Department of Transportation (LADOT), Bureau of Engineering (BOE), Bureau of Street Services (BSS), and Bureau of Street Lighting (BSL) to provide a current list of the City's active transportation projects and associated grant deadlines, including, but not limited to:
Protected bicycle lanes and paths
Pedestrian safety improvements
Neighborhood greenways
Sidewalk improvements associated with corridor upgrades
Prioritizing projects that are located on the City's High Injury Network
Improving access to transit stations, major job centers, and key entertainment and sporting venues
Serving disadvantaged communities
Locations along the Festival Trail or extend the existing network of non-vehicular paths.
INSTRUCT the City Administrative Officer (CAO), with assistance from the LADOT, BOE, BSS, and BSL, to identify adequate staffing levels and evaluate funding options, including the feasibility of utilizing Municipal Improvement Corporation of Los Angeles lease revenue bonds, that would provide the necessary staff resources and project implementation costs to deliver the City's active transportation projects.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the CAO nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: City motion regarding the City's current active transportation projects and associated grant deadlines.
